speaker: Doctor
text: I see you are experiencing fatigue, flank pain, and fever following recent antibiotic treatment for acute sinusitis. To understand what might be going on, have you noticed any changes in the color, smell, or amount of your urine?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Pyelonephritis.

Given your history of acute sinusitis treated with antibiotics, followed by the development of fever, fatigue, and flank pain, it is highly likely the initial antibiotic course did not fully eradicate a uropathogen, or you have developed a secondary infection. The persistence of these symptoms despite improvement in sinusitis suggests an ascending urinary tract infection that has progressed to the kidneys. Have you experienced any symptoms of a urinary tract infection such as burning during urination, urgency, or increased frequency?
